scope: Strict native-fallback release validation for H3MR Stage-3-BIR plus Adaptive VDA
summary: The final release candidate makes every rejected V2 route a bit-exact fallback for all original Stage-3-BIR fields, retains the accepted aggregate metrics, and passes a fresh full-pipeline audit.
evidence: A fresh one-command run completed generation, official evaluation, and audit with exit status zero over 20 sequences and 40 hand trajectories.
All 38 ordinary-route hand outputs passed the fallback-exactness condition; the 16 hand outputs from eight rejected ordinary sequences preserve every original Stage-3-BIR field bit-for-bit.

All 38 ordinary-route hand outputs passed finite modified-field, coordinate consistency, reprojection, camera-field, validity-mask, and local-geometry checks; both hard-route outputs are exact frozen-V1 copies.
W-MPJPE, WA-MPJPE, RTE, and Accel remain 23.941061 mm, 14.584753 mm, 1.031538%, and 6.406733 m/s^2, respectively, with PA-MPJPE numerically invariant at 6.904049 mm.
Eleven Adaptive VDA and cache-adapter regression tests plus targeted Ruff and Python compilation checks pass.
lessons: A semantic fallback must preserve every protected field exactly; recomputing an unchanged 2D projection can introduce needless floating-point differences even when evaluation metrics are unaffected.
Fail-closed output-state handling must distinguish candidate generation from later evaluate and audit phases so immutable candidates can be consumed without permitting result overwrites.
limitations: The accepted metrics remain H2O Train20 GT-2D upper-bound development evidence rather than an independent test-set result.

The full runner consumes external precomputed model outputs and private evaluation assets; the repository contains the fusion, routing, evaluation adapter, and audit code but not upstream checkpoints.
next_actions: Obtain user review before committing or pushing the prepared repository changes.
Run the frozen release on a predeclared external challenge set before making a broad generalization claim.
